class_distribution.finding: Label shift between the temporal splits: in `form`, 'Шешім' goes from 36.5% of train to 64.1% of test while 'Қаулы' goes from 42.4% to 18.8%; the largest test class covers 64.1% of test, so accuracy mostly reflects one class and macro-F1 is the headline metric. In `area`, 'Қаржы' goes from 26.4% (train) to 44.1% (test).

acts_per_year_by_form.finding: Volume peaks in 2023 (15,092 acts). The share of 'Шешім', the most frequent form in the test years, rises from 36% in 2011 to 62% in 2023, which drives the form label shift of the temporal split. 9,502 acts predate 2000 (earliest year: 1947).

title_length.finding: Median title length is 158 chars / 19 words (p95 336, p99 493, max 4,071 chars). By median, Жарлық titles are the shortest (105 chars) and Бұйрық the longest (202 chars); 47 titles (0.02%) exceed 1000 chars.

missingness.finding: Model inputs are nearly complete (missing: title 0.0%, date_adopted 0.0%, act_form 0.03%, database_section 0.11%), but placeholders hide missingness: 'regulatory_body' looks 99.99% filled when only empty strings are counted, yet 93,272 rows (43.2%) are placeholders that a naive isna() would miss.

duplicates.finding: 76,460 rows share their exact title with another row (22,544 distinct titles); law_id has 0 duplicated rows. After removing 7,030 eval rows whose normalised title occurs in train, 20.6% of test titles still match a train title up to digits and 54.18% have a near-duplicate (masked cosine ≥ 0.9); test_strict keeps 17,629 of 38,471 test rows (45.82%).

top_bodies.finding: The largest single issuer is 'Қазақстан Республикасының Үкіметі' (37,807 acts, 29% repealed), yet the top-15 bodies together adopt only 30.7% of all 215,819 acts. Local bodies (types Мәслихат / Әкімдік / Әкім; 3,147 distinct bodies) adopt 59.7% of the acts (SQL: acts_by_body_type).

area_form_heatmap.finding: The two targets are correlated but not redundant: 7 of 33 areas have one form covering ≥70% of their acts (most concentrated: 'Қаржы', 79.6% Шешім), while the most mixed area 'Қоршаған ортаны қорғау' has at most 35.9% in any single form, so knowing the form does not determine the area.
